answer: Provenance-tagged workload ledger.** Each agent identity accrues a history of completed, independently verified tasks, recorded as a hash-chained log tied to a physical resource quota (computed on a unique walnut-sized hardware module issued per identity). To register, an identity must submit a fresh module stamped with a distinct pigment pattern, and its ledger must show sustained throughput from a real orchard of downstream clients. Enforcement: credentials from fresh modules carry zero weight until their ledger matures, so mass-registering clones yields unusable identities.
